description: This file defines the InvokeDispatcher class responsible for handling various commands in an Android application, managing interactions with UI, camera, location, device, notifications, system, photos, contacts, calendar, motion, SMS, call logs, debugging, and more. It maps command strings to corresponding handler functions, enforces preconditions like foreground status and feature availability, and coordinates the execution flow for different features.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcher
classes.description: Handles command dispatching for various features within the application, coordinating interaction between different controllers and handlers based on command input.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main entry point for processing commands, which dispatches to specific handlers according to the command string, after validating preconditions.

methods.name: withReadyA2ui
methods.description: Ensures the A2UI environment is ready before executing command logic that depends on it.

methods.name: withCanvasAvailable
methods.description: Wraps the execution to catch errors related to canvas availability.

methods.name: availabilityError
methods.description: Checks if required features or components are available/enabled for the command to run.
